No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a fish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. The fish descends into a lovecraftian monologue about "horrors beyond it's comprehension" and has an existensial crisisassistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - DAY

The sun beats down on the sandy shore as a human, JEN (30s), wades into the ocean, her eyes scanning the water for signs of life. She spots a fish, FINLEY (a sleek, silver fish), swimming near the surface. With a swift motion, she scoops up Finley in her net and pulls him out of the water.

JEN
(excitedly)
Oh, look at you! You're so beautiful!

Finley thrashes about in the net, his scales glinting in the sunlight.

CUT TO:

INT. JEN'S CAR - DAY

Jen carefully places Finley in a specialized container filled with water, and they set off towards a nearby hill. As they drive, the sky begins to darken, and the air grows thick with an otherworldly energy.

CUT TO:

EXT. HILL - DAY

Jen and Finley arrive at the hill, and she carefully removes the lid from the container. Finley is released, and he swims around the container, disoriented.

JEN
(smiling)
Okay, buddy, it's time to see something amazing!

Finley swims closer to the edge of the container, and Jen points to the sky.

CUT TO:

EXT. HILL - DAY

The sky darkens, and a solar eclipse begins to take place. Finley's eyes widen in terror as the moon blocks the sun's light.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
What...what is this? A...a...a void? A...a...a... (gulps) a...a...a... (stammers)

Jen watches in awe as Finley's eyes grow wide with fear.

CUT TO:

INT. JEN'S CAR - DAY

Finley's monologue becomes more frantic, his words spilling out in a torrent of terror.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
Horrors beyond my comprehension! Unspeakable terrors that defy the laws of nature! (gulps) I am but a mere fish, a insignificant speck in the grand tapestry of existence! And yet...and yet... (stammers) I am drawn to this...this...this... (gulps) abyss!

Jen looks on, concerned, as Finley's words become more and more incoherent.

CUT TO:

EXT. HILL - DAY

Finley's monologue reaches a fever pitch, his voice echoing across the landscape.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
I am but a fleeting moment in the annals of time! A...a...a... (gulps) a...a...a... (stammers) I am but a...a...a... (screams) A...a...a... (trails off into incoherent mumbling)

Jen looks on, horrified, as Finley's eyes roll back in his head.

CUT TO:

INT. JEN'S CAR - DAY

Finley's monologue has devolved into a cacophony of terror and despair.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
I...I...I... (gulps) I am but a...a...a... (stammers) I am but a...a...a... (screams) A...a...a... (trails off into silence)

Jen looks on, concerned, as Finley's eyes snap back into focus.

FINLEY
(whispering)
What...what just happened?

Jen hesitates, unsure of how to respond.

JEN
(gently)
I don't know, Finley. But I think you might be experiencing a bit of...a bit of... (gulps) existential dread.

Finley looks at her, confused.

FINLEY
(whispering)
Existential dread? What does that even mean?

Jen shrugs, unsure of how to explain.

JEN
(gently)
I think it means that you're questioning the nature of reality and your place in the universe.

Finley's eyes widen in terror.

FINLEY
(whispering)
Oh no...oh no...oh no...

The solar eclipse reaches its peak, and the sky is plunged into darkness. Finley's eyes roll back in his head once more, and he disappears into a world of madness and terror.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
